evidence.quote: We propose a $30 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members, plus up to $6 million in court-approved attorneys’ fees and expenses.
We can retain your proposed fee terms and resolve the case with a $28 million class fund.
Brightline can meet you halfway on the remaining difference with a $27.25 million class fund. The $5 million court-approved fee cap

summary: Plaintiff first raised attorneys’ fees in its opening public proposal. Fees were negotiated before class relief was finally settled because the parties agreed on a $5 million fee cap while continuing to bargain over the class fund. The transcript does not show a tradeoff of class relief for fees, plaintiff self-dealing, defense exploitation of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
